# Nationwide Latency and Core DNS Degradation Incident Report

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** core_degradation at `CORE-DNS-01`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence of DNS degradation observed on CORE-DNS-01 with resolution times above baseline and a major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE alarm. Maintenance and changes were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-08 10:00 to 2026-09-08 12:29
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-08 10:00
- **Affected:** CORE-DNS-01, CORE-UPF-01, S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-004

## Summary

Core DNS degradation on CORE-DNS-01 leading to increased resolution times and dropped query success rates, triggering nationwide latency complaints.

Nationwide latency complaints and resolution time spikes affecting sites and core nodes starting at 10:00 on 2026-09-08 and fully recovering by 12:29 when the alarm cleared.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-08 10:00: Earliest onset of national latency deviation and core resolution_ms above baseline, alongside anomaly detector alert ALR-0008. [T1, T6, T7, ALR-0008, ANM-000091]
- 2026-09-08 10:22: Major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE alarm ALM-000157 raised on CORE-DNS-01. [T3, T8, ALM-000157, RB-ALARM-REFERENCE#07]
- 2026-09-08 12:29: Major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE alarm ALM-000157 cleared on CORE-DNS-01, concluding the impact. [T8, ALM-000157]

## Evidence

- National latency and CORE-DNS-01 resolution time showed deviations starting at 2026-09-08 10:00. [T6, T7]
- A major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE alarm (ALM-000157) was raised on CORE-DNS-01 at 10:22 and cleared at 12:29. [T8, ALM-000157]
- No configuration changes occurred on CORE-DNS-01, CORE-UPF-01, or their parents between 2026-09-08 06:00 and 12:30. [T2, T5]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on CORE-DNS-01, CORE-UPF-01, or their parents between 2026-09-08 06:00 and 12:30. [T4]

## Hypotheses

1. **core_degradation** at CORE-DNS-01: confirmed. Directly supported by core KPI degradation on CORE-DNS-01, matching anomaly onset times and a major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE alarm. [T7, T8, ALM-000157, RB-DNS-DEGRADATION#02]

3. **planned_maintenance** at CORE-DNS-01: rejected. Maintenance calendar check confirmed no scheduled windows. [T4]

## Recommended actions

- Monitor CORE-DNS-01 query success rates and resolution times continuously.
- Investigate underlying causes for sudden DNS resolution spikes.
